newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ lowers key business loan rate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ lowers key business loan rate.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Thursday it would cut its business reference (prime) rate for major customers to 9.35 percent from 9.85 percent, effective January 20 next year.

ANZ, one of Australia's four major banks with large retail and wholesale operations in each state, also said it would reduce its business index rate by the same amount of 50 basis points to 9.75 percent.
Like other banks, the ANZ has already passed on the 50 basis point cut in official cash rates to its mortgage customers.

The RBA eased official cash to 6.0 percent on Wednesday, citing the positive inflation outlook, with Treasurer Peter Costello calling on the banks to immediately pass on the full reduction to their customers.
